messages:
emily: opened a tiny docs PR to introduce `compat-tags` in model cards and clarify annotation formats (suffixes vs metadata fields). PR: https://git.company/redwood/docs/pull/6212 :wave:
ryan: nice. is this additive to the existing `+adapter`/`:int8` suffixes or a replacement?
emily: additive. goal is to give catalog consumers a machine-friendly hint: `compat-tags: ["adapter-aware", "kv-merged", "int8-compatible"]` so tooling can make smarter routing decisions. human-readable examples still use suffixes for convenience.
anika: can you show how SDKs should prefer tags over string parsing? folks have been string-parsing model names in infra code and it's brittle.
emily: added JS + Python snippets showing `route_selector` using `compat_tags` instead of name parsing:
```js
// prefer adapter-aware variants when available
route_selector: {
  require_tags: ["adapter-aware"],
  prefer_tags: ["int8-compatible"]
}
```
```python
# python snippet
route_selector = {"require_tags": ["adapter-aware"], "prefer_tags": ["int8-compatible"]}
client.create_route(model="polaris13b+adapter:zephyrus-v2", route_selector=route_selector)
```
ben: love the idea. add a small migration note: support teams must still handle older customers who rely on name parsing, so document a fallback section on how to map existing suffixes to tags.
emily: added a migration table mapping common suffixes -> tags and a tiny shim example: `compat_tags = infer_tags_from_name(model_name) // fallback for older tooling`. Also suggested deprecation timeline for parsing: "encourage tag-first; parsing deprecated in 6 months."
ryan: include a short Terraform sample too for infra teams that use HCL to create routes.
emily: added HCL example:
```hcl
resource "redwood_route" "summarizer" {
  name = "summarizer"
  model = "polaris13b+adapter:zephyrus-v2"
  route_selector = jsonencode({ require_tags = ["adapter-aware"], prefer_tags = ["int8-compatible"] })
  max_total_tokens = 8192
}
```
anika: QA wants a minimal eval set and a quick smoke script that asserts routing picks an adapter-aware variant when available. can you add examples/compat-tag-smoke.md?
emily: added 3 prompts + a small `rwctl route test` example. smoke script outline: 1) push a temporary catalog entry with `compat-tags: ["adapter-aware"]`, 2) create a test route with `require_tags: ["adapter-aware"]`, 3) run 3 prompts and assert non-zero adapter-flag in response metadata.
qa-bot: I ran the smoke script against a local preview catalog  passes. Quick run link: https://ci.company/qa-runs/14521
docs-ci-bot: PR 6212 docs build: success \u2705 \u2014 preview: https://docs-preview.company/6212
ben: editorial: soften shippers' language around exact output parity. change any "will match" to "aims to preserve intent" and call out tokenization caveats.
emily: done. I also added a brief release note blurb and flagged support to include the shim snippet in their KB.
ryan: LGTM. once QE posts a full cluster run, merge. this should stop a bunch of fragile infra hacks.
emily: thanks all  pinging QE for full run and will merge after green. :shipit:
